---
title: "Scientific illustrations across disciplines"
subtitle: "A collection of visuals designed to translate complex concepts and support understanding across a wide range of scientific expertise."
description : |
  Covering topics ranging from mass spectrometry and molecular biology to thermodynamics, probabilistic ML/AI, linear algebra, experimental design, and statistics, these selected figures illustrate **how visual communication can make complex concepts more accessible and intuitive**.

  Many of these ideas are **difficult to explain efficiently through text alone**. By combining abstraction, synthesis, and visual reasoning, these figures help translate specialised knowledge into forms that can be understood across different scientific backgrounds.

  Full-quality images, detailed legends, and references can be found in my PhD thesis [@LeSueurThesis].
